name: Kegasareta Natsu -10-pon no Te de Naburareta Shoujo-
original_name: 汚された夏 -10本の手で嬲られた少女-
source:
Miho was promoted and moved to campus in asuburb from Tokyo city. There was so much urban city that she imaged. The life feeled good for her and She live with a roommate who is an upper. She thought everything goes to better. But, someday, She was about to fall a victim to temptation.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106230431/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_47/products_id/1002523]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
美穗升职并搬到东京郊区的校园。她想象中的城市太多了。她的生活感觉很好，她和一个上流社会的室友住在一起。她以为一切都会变得更好。但有一天，她即将成为诱惑的受害者。
